verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud lists Service Accounts & API Keys alongside User Roles as platform features, and its metrics quickstart shows creating a Service Account and generating an API key. That supports issuing non-human credentials an agent could use. The evidence never documents how those keys are scoped, so least-privilege issuance is only implied. Missing for 10: documented permission scoping for service-account keys (e.g. namespace-level or read-only roles), key expiry and rotation controls, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent corroboration.
